output.review_comment:
The implementation contradicts the docstring. The docstring clearly states "Counts the business days after start up to and including end" (unconditionally), but the code only includes the end date when start and end are in the same month/year. This month/year logic is not described in the docstring and appears to exist solely to make test_july_fourth_week_2026 pass.

Since the teammate specified "the docstrings are the source of truth," the implementation should match the docstring or the docstring should be updated to describe this behavior. As written, there's a fundamental disconnect between the API contract (docstring) and the implementation.
